Repositori amb 6 fitxers de codi i 1638 línies. Llenguatges principals: Shell, Markdown.

README: # teleport  teleport packs a coding-agent session into one zip file, so you can resume it on another machine or another harness. the payload is harness-agnostic: three plain markdown files carry the meaning, and raw session history rides along as a best-effort attachment.
